items.heading: Overview
items.paragraph:
This course delves into policy, projects, and societal impact. We'll cover data governance issues, how to design your own AI projects, and broader societal challenges like copyright implications and potential misuses. For those interested, we'll also provide guidance on developing AI governance policies.

After each video ends, a continue button appears below the video player. Click it to reveal the additional navigation and the InnovateUS website link containing readings and resources. Learners with screen readers can use the down arrow key to navigate through the video player’s controls and access the continue button. Another “continue” button will appear to move on to the Self-Assessments after each video.

  • Reminder: Consult with your organization’s policies before using any tool or platform.  

  • Disclaimer: The commercial tools mentioned in this course are for illustrative purposes and do not imply endorsement by InnovateUS.

items.title: CONTINUE
